why: The cards use 'wild oxen' (Psalm 22:21, Isaiah 34:7), meaning untamed animals. The sources only describe domestic oxen as farm animals. Smith's says cattle grazing in the open might become fierce and wild, but it never explains what the 'wild oxen' in these verses are. Webster's only says 'ox' can apply to wild bovine animals in general. No source explains this biblical use, so no meaning can be written without adding outside knowledge.
